path.description: Path relative to the connection's base_url; no scheme, host, query or fragment.

query.description: Query parameters; a value may be a string, number, boolean or an array of them.

headers.description: Only Accept, Accept-Language, If-None-Match, If-Modified-Since, Range, Content-Type, If-Match and If-Unmodified-Since.

method.description: POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE, if the connection lists it in drafts.

body.description: The body: a string is sent as is (default Content-Type text/plain), any other JSON value as compact JSON (default application/json). At most 256 KiB; never a secret.
